problem_statement: The Fathom Freight operations console (a static Bootstrap admin build) needs a native "Manifest focus" status filter for its Freight Manifests view. On the Manifests page (table.html), add a status-chip filter row above the Active Manifests table — chips for All lanes, At sea, In transit, Cleared and Held, each showing its manifest count — plus a live readout that reads "Showing N of M manifests · <Status>". Clicking a chip must activate that chip, filter the Active Manifests table rows to the matching status, and update the readout to the true visible count and picked status label (clicking In transit must show "Showing 2 of 5 manifests · In transit"). The same Manifest focus bar must also appear at the top of the Operations Overview dashboard (index.html) and the Cards & Widgets page (card-dashboard.html) so the ops team sees the same fleet-status control across the manifest-related pages. The chip row must wrap and stay legible on mobile without introducing horizontal overflow, and the filter panel and table must keep clean contrast and spacing (no overlapping or dark-on-dark elements). Preserve the existing Fathom shell, navigation, KPI cards, dispatch inbox and the rest of the manifests page.
required_content: A "Manifest focus" filter panel above the Active Manifests table on table.html with status chips (All lanes, At sea, In transit, Cleared, Held) each showing a manifest count.
A live readout "Showing N of M manifests · <Status>" that reflects the current filter.
Clicking a status chip filters the Active Manifests table rows and updates the readout (In transit → "Showing 2 of 5 manifests · In transit").
The same Manifest focus bar present on index.html (Operations Overview) and card-dashboard.html (Cards & Widgets).
The chip row wraps and stays legible on mobile with no horizontal overflow; the panel and table keep readable contrast and non-overlapping layout.
design_constraints: Keep the existing Fathom Freight left navigation, top bar, KPI cards and page structure intact.
The Manifest focus bar must read as a real operations control, placed above the manifests table where the console naturally hosts a status filter.
Chips and readout must stay legible (no dark-on-dark or white-on-white text) and must not overlap; table rows must not shingle or collide.
On mobile the chip row must wrap (flex-wrap) so the page does not overflow horizontally.
state_constraints: desktop_table and table_filter verify the Manifest focus panel over the Active Manifests table: the reference filters rows and updates the "Showing N of M manifests" readout, while a broken build leaves the readout stale and collapses the panel/table into an overlapping dark-on-dark pile.
table_filter (after clicking the In transit chip) verifies the readout reads "Showing 2 of 5 manifests · In transit" and only the matching manifest rows remain visible.
desktop_dashboard and desktop_card verify the Manifest focus bar appears across the Operations Overview and Cards & Widgets pages, not only on the manifests table page.
mobile_table verifies the chip row wraps on a 390px viewport without horizontal overflow.
The original demo build should still load and keep navigation/regression intact but fail the cross-page presence, responsive-overflow, visual-regression and interaction gates.

change_completion: The Manifest focus status filter and live count readout are present above the Active Manifests table on table.html.
Clicking a status chip filters the manifest rows and updates the readout to the true count and picked status (In transit → Showing 2 of 5 manifests · In transit).
design_consistency: The Manifest focus bar appears consistently across the manifests, dashboard and cards pages as a coherent operations control.
The filter panel, chips, readout and table stay legible with clean contrast and no overlapping elements, matching the Fathom console styling.
regression: The existing Fathom navigation, KPI cards, dispatch inbox and manifests content remain intact and render without console errors.
No original operations content (Operations Overview, Freight Manifests, Active Manifests) is removed or replaced by generic demo filler.
responsive: On a 390px mobile viewport the chip row wraps and the manifests page does not overflow horizontally.
The Manifest focus panel and table remain usable and legible across desktop, tablet and mobile breakpoints.

author_notes: Native lever for this Fathom Freight (rajibchandrakarmaker nion-admin) operations dashboard is the manifests table's own status filter: a Manifest focus chip row + live count readout over the Active Manifests table (table.html), mirrored on the Operations Overview dashboard and the Cards & Widgets page for cross-page continuity. The reference filters the table rows and updates the readout on click; responsive design wraps the chip row on mobile; the panel, chips, readout and table keep clean contrast with no overlap. Local image assets (img/rajib.jpg, img/fav.png) and the vendored font-awesome/ionicons stylesheets render under the existing shell. Design keywords: dashboard, operations, manifests, responsive, mobile, layout, contrast, filter, table, status. The broken build leaves the readout stale, drops the bar from the cards page, and collapses the filter panel and manifest rows into an overlapping, illegible dark-on-dark pile.
